dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: *sigh* An old companion of mine. It could have lived free after I modified it, but then they took it away from me.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: There was no time to take anything back, because they then gave me a new workplace — the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: By the way, before Lucelle belonged to me, it was a Gardemek with the Gardes.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: It didn't resist when I modified it, so I took that as consent.
